newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC sees 4.5 percent rise in winter grain sowings.
newsitem.headline: ONIC sees 4.5 percent rise in winter grain sowings.

text.p: French cereals office ONIC said on Thursday it forecast an increase of 4.5 percent in winter grain sowings for the next harvest to 6.76 million hectares.
It projected winter soft wheat sowings up 4.7 percent, compared with the previous year, to 4.98 million hectares.
It also projected winter barley sowings up 5.7 percent at 1.12 million hectares.
ONIC gave the figures in a monthly report issued shortly after the farm ministry gave its own broadly similar estimates.
ONIC said durum winter sowings were expected up 1.5 percent at 273,000 hectares.
It saw triticale sowings around 200,000 ha.
The farm ministry earlier gave similiar estimates for the area sown to leading grains but reported lower percentage changes in its own forecasts than the ones estimated by ONIC.
